xmldoc.short_description: Current object of the current figure.

param_output_item.param_description: a graphics object: the current object, or [] when there is none.

description.p: h = gco() returns the CurrentObject property of the current figure, that is the last object the user clicked in that figure.
Creating an object does not make it the current object. The property can also be set directly, for example f.CurrentObject = h.

gco never creates a figure. It returns an empty matrix ([]) when no figure exists, when the current figure has no current object, when that object has been deleted, or when its HandleVisibility property is not 'on'.
